description: Use this when the user asks a free-text theatre question (best musical for kids, romantic show tonight, cheap comedy). Returns a concise grounded answer plus cited theatre products with booking URLs. Intent-aware (budget, audience, timeframe) via the concierge seam.

city.description: City name, resolved to a slug.

format.description: Response shape. 'json' returns structured records; 'text' returns the same content rendered as a short narrative paragraph for chat surfaces.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

name: ask_theatre_concierge
